target_audience.primary_persona: Career-focused professionals seeking to enhance their LinkedIn presence through visually compelling banners
secondary_personas: Career coaches creating branded materials for clients
Marketing professionals managing personal or company brands
Job seekers wanting to stand out with professional profiles
HR professionals and recruiters building employer brand
Personal brand consultants creating assets for clients
Content creators building thought leadership presence
pain_points: Lack of design skills to create professional-looking banners
Time-consuming manual design process with traditional tools
Difficulty maintaining brand consistency across visual assets
LinkedIn's specific dimension requirements causing cropping issues
Expensive professional design services for simple banner updates
Generic templates that don't reflect unique personal brand
No easy way to iterate on designs quickly with AI assistance
goals: Create professional LinkedIn banners in minutes, not hours
Establish a memorable and cohesive personal brand
Stand out in competitive job markets or professional networks
Maintain brand consistency across all professional touchpoints
Quickly A/B test different banner designs
Use voice commands for hands-free design iteration
target_audience.usage_context: Professionals use Nanobanna Pro when updating their LinkedIn profile for job searches, career pivots, personal branding refreshes, or seasonal updates. Often accessed during evening/weekend personal branding sessions or as part of career coaching workflows.

product_vision.one_liner: AI-powered LinkedIn banner designer that creates stunning, professional banners in seconds with voice-powered workflows
product_vision.problem_statement: Creating professional LinkedIn banners requires design skills most professionals don't have, forcing them to use generic templates, pay for expensive designers, or settle for subpar visuals that don't reflect their personal brand
product_vision.value_proposition: Nanobanna Pro combines cutting-edge multi-model AI (Gemini, GPT, Claude) with voice-powered workflows to let anyone create 4K professional banners through natural conversation, eliminating the design skills barrier while enabling rapid iteration and brand consistency
success_metrics: Number of banners generated per user per month
Time from start to exported banner (target: under 5 minutes)
Voice command adoption rate (% users using voice features)
Net Promoter Score (NPS) from Careersy community
Conversion from free to paid tier
Design save/re-edit rate (indicates value in saved designs)

existing_features: Canvas-based editor with layers and safe zones
AI image generation via Gemini 3 Pro (4K resolution)
Voice-powered creation with 17 commands via OpenAI Realtime API
Image processing: upscaling, background removal, restoration, face enhancement
Magic edit functionality for iterative refinement
Brainstorm tab for AI-assisted prompt ideation
Tool chain builder for automated workflows
Admin dashboard with finance and observability
Multi-tenant auth with RLS (Row Level Security)
Encrypted API key storage per user
Preview mode for cost-controlled image operations
known_gaps: ChatInterface Phase 2 components not yet exported
Profile updates handling in chat incomplete
LinkedIn OAuth integration for direct publishing
technical_debt: Admin check uses existence check instead of proper useAdminAuth hook
Some ChatInterface components still in Phase 1 structure
Profile updates need better state management in chat context
Test coverage could be expanded for newer features
Some voice error diagnostics utilities may need consolidation

alternatives: Canva - General-purpose design with LinkedIn templates
Adobe Express - Professional design suite with AI features
Visme - Business graphics and presentation tool
LinkedIn's native banner upload - Manual upload only
Figma - Professional design tool (steep learning curve)
Fotor - Online photo editor with banner templates
differentiators: Voice-first design: 17 voice commands for hands-free creation
Multi-model AI orchestration (Gemini + GPT + Claude + Replicate)
LinkedIn-specific optimization with safe zones and dimension presets
4K resolution output for print-quality professional results
Multi-turn image editing with AI memory context
Brand consistency engine for automatic guideline enforcement
Tool chain automation for complex multi-step workflows
Preview mode for cost-controlled AI operations
competitive_context.market_position: Premium AI-native design tool positioned specifically for LinkedIn professionals, sitting between consumer-grade template tools (Canva) and professional design suites (Figma). Unique value in voice-powered workflows and LinkedIn-specific optimization.

technical: Requires API keys from multiple providers (Gemini, OpenRouter, Replicate, OpenAI)
Voice features require Chrome/Edge browser and microphone permissions
WebSocket connections needed for real-time voice streaming
Heavy reliance on external AI services (single points of failure)
CORS handling required for Replicate proxy in development
resources: Primary development by small team (2-3 contributors based on git history)
Pilot program targeting Careersy community initially
Two deployment modes: user-hosted (BYOK) and pilot-hosted (shared quota)
Invite-only during pilot phase limits user growth
AI API costs scale with usage (need cost management)
dependencies: Google Gemini API for primary image generation
OpenAI Realtime API for voice agent
Google Cloud Storage for file storage
Langfuse for LLM observability and tracing
